DIAGNOSIS READY: Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy with Radiculopathy (C7-C8 levels).

Given the year-long burning pain, paresthesias, and progressive bilateral hand weakness in a 58-year-old male, this presentation is highly suggestive of cervical spondylotic myelopathy. I would like to confirm if you have experienced any recent falls or specific neck trauma before these symptoms began. Also, have you noticed difficulty with fine motor tasks, such as buttoning shirts or holding a glass, or any gait instability?
